title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, August 17-23
content: The My Neighbor Totoro anime film aired on NTV on Friday, August 21 at 9:00 p.m. and it earned a 10.0% rating. The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region.
author: ANN

title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists
content: The second season will premiere on October 1. The new season will again air on Thursdays at 11:56 p.m. (10:56 a.m. EDT) on TBS and 27 affiliated channels. It will also stream on Netflix , as well as other services in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless First Anime Ending Featuring "Michishirube" by Keita Tachibana
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its very first ending, featuring the song “Michishirube” by Keita Tachibana. The song was used in Episodes 1-12, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fungus and Iron TV Anime Reveals Director, Yokohama Animation Lab Animation Studio
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayaka Katayama 's Fungus and Iron ( Kin to Tetsu ) manga revealed the anime's second teaser visual and director, on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Shungiku Uchida's Minami's Lover Manga Gets Musical Stage Play in December
content: A website opened on August 31 to announce the musical stage play adaptation of Shungiku Uchida 's Minami's Lover ( Minami-kun no Koibito ) manga, which will run on December 6-16 at the Nippon Seinenkan Hall in Tokyo.
author: ANN

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Expansion Introduces Boosted Actions Feature in Videos
content: CAPCOM revealed a new trailer on Wednesday for the upcoming Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game introducing the Boosted Actions feature. CAPCOM also revealed videos on Wednesday and Thursday detailing the Boosted Action feature for different weapon types.
author: ANN

title: 'Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lily Part 2' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Songs
content: The official website of the Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ) original television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, theme songs, and the main visual (pictured) for its second part on Thursday. The second part is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Nao Maita Launches New Manga on December 28
content: The October issue of Shogakukan 's Ciao magazine revealed on Thursday that manga creator Nao Maita will launch a new manga in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 28. The announcement did not reveal the manga's title or other details. The same issue published the final chapter of Maita's Shining!
author: ANN

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Opens at #1, Chiikawa Film Drops to #2
content: Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, ranked at #1 in its opening weekend.
author: ANN
